text: Backend: stop writing aim files from the read path
description: Audit finding (2026-09-28). server.ts readAim migrates legacy fields (outgoing -> supportedAims) and replaces [0,0] relativePositions with random ones, writing the file back — during every aim.get/aim.list. Reads therefore mutate the repo (noisy .bowman diffs, races with concurrent writers/agents, nondeterministic positions). Move these migrations into an explicit, idempotent migration step (project open / fix_consistency) and make readAim pure.

status.comment: readAim is pure: normalizeAimRecord upgrades incoming/outgoing in memory only. [0,0] (schema-default) connection positions are now placed in writeAim, where writes happen anyway. migrateAimFiles persists legacy upgrades explicitly and runs first in project.fixConsistency (reported as 'Upgraded ...' fixes).

reflection: Verified: backend vitest 75/75 incl. new test asserting aim.get + aim.list leave a [0,0]-linked aim file byte-identical and fixConsistency places it; legacy incoming/outgoing tests now assert the file is untouched by reads and upgraded by fixConsistency. tsc clean. Scan of .query procedures found no other aim writes. Found the same read-writes pattern for phases (readPhaseFile reconcile + silent writePhase) — filed as a separate aim.
